passage.label: Ha-Meem Ayn-Seen-Qaf; thus revealed to you and to those before you by the Mighty Wise; His is whatever is in heavens and earth, Most High Most Great; heavens almost break from above while angels exalt with praise and seek forgiveness for those on earth, He Forgiving Merciful; those taking allies besides Him have Allah as Guardian and the Prophet is not a manager over them; an Arabic Quran revealed to warn the Mother of Cities and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly with one party in Paradise and one in the Blaze; had He willed He could have made them one religion but admits whom He wills into mercy while wrongdoers have no protector or helper; Allah alone is Protector giving life to the dead, competent over all; ruling in any disagreement referred to Allah with reliance and turning back; Creator of heavens and earth making mates from yourselves and among cattle, multiplying thereby, nothing like unto Him, Hearing Seeing; keys of heavens and earth His, provision extended and restricted, Knowing of all

arabicExcerpts.text: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِيٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِن فَوۡقِهِنَّۚ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ لِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٖ
وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡجَمۡعِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ فَرِيقٞ فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٞ فِي ٱلسَّعِيرِ
وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَلَٰكِن يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
وَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفۡتُمۡ فِيهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ فَحُكۡمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ أُنِيبُ
فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ أَزۡوَٰجٗا يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيهِۚ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٞۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ

mainSubject.label: The double letter-opening followed by the disclosure that the same revelation given to Muhammad was given to those before him by the Mighty Wise; cosmic ownership paired with loftiness and greatness; the heavens nearly breaking while angels praise and seek forgiveness for earth-dwellers, framed by forgiveness and mercy; rival-alliance takers left under divine guardianship with prophetic managership denied; the Arabic Quran commissioned to warn the Mother of Cities and its surroundings of the undoubted Day of Assembly dividing humanity between Paradise and Blaze; unity of religion possible by will yet mercy admitted selectively while wrongdoers lack protector and helper; exclusive protectorship proved by giving life to the dead; every dispute referred to Allah with reliance and return; creation of the cosmos and of human and cattle mates enabling multiplication, sealed by the negation of any likeness and by hearing and sight; the keys of the cosmos and the extension and restriction of provision under complete knowledge

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the keys-and-provision affirmation (12) before the shared-religion ordinance opens (13); P2 ends with answered supplication and bounty (26); P3 is the measured-provision, rain, creature and ship sign block ending with the no-escape notice (27-35); P4 begins with the worldly-versus-lasting contrast and runs through the consultative community profile, retribution ethics, judgement scenes and the modes of revelation to the closing evolution of all matters (36-53).
